audit_scope: Worker-4 source-reviewed every linked DBAASP/DRAMP row against local XML/PDF/supplement/database snapshots. Supported MIC90 and citation rows were verified; figure-derived exact antibiofilm values and unsupported broad DRAMP activity labels were preserved as source_conflict.
tools_attempted: image inspection for figure-level exact-value recoverability

source_review_findings.table_1_identity: Table 1 gives designations, primary sequences, length/net charge/hydrophobicity, and states that bold residues are D-enantiomers and all peptides are C-terminal amidated.
source_review_findings.peptide_synthesis: Experimental peptide synthesis uses rink amide resin and Fmoc solid-phase synthesis, with D Lys/Leu at positions 3, 6, 8, 9, and 13 and >95% purity by RP-HPLC/TOF-MS.
source_review_findings.table_2_mic90: Table 2 reports MIC90 values in micromolar for 19 CF clinical P. aeruginosa isolates plus PAO1 using 24 h broth microdilution.
source_review_findings.biofilm_exact_values: Biofilm inhibition/degradation evidence is figure/prose supported, but exact database percentage/MBEC values are not fully recoverable as structured primary-source table values from local text.
source_review_findings.dramp_activity_conflict: The paper supports antimicrobial and antibiofilm activity, but not an anticancer activity claim for the linked DRAMP row.
